artMethod: Raster art generated with imagegen from Luffy costume references and the native HD protagonist poses. Technical packing preserves original RGBA pixels without resampling.

itemIcon.origin: User supplied Luffy em pixel art com moldura dourada(1).png, copied byte for byte

west: Per-frame horizontal mirror of East, same time order. This also mirrors asymmetries and equipment handedness.
skillBodies: Shared offensive/channeling poses are declared bodyShared in atlas.json; existing gameplay clocks and VFX remain authoritative.
runtime: Only the currently requested source is loaded; decoded image cache is limited to 12 atlases. Missing images fall back to the native character.
